notes: B-112 repro (fixer A wave 4, 2026-10-30; the Archfiend's Vessel compiler item). Printed: '... exile it. IF YOU DO, create a 5/5 black Demon creature token with flying.' The Vessel enters from seat 0's graveyard (the enter op binds the card where it is) with its trigger held; in response (the runner's stand-in, R5-1) another effect returns the Vessel to its owner's hand. When the trigger resolves the Vessel is not on the battlefield, so it is not exiled: you did not exile it, and no Demon may be created.
